from pathlib import Path
p = Path('lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart')
text = p.read_text()
anchor_line = "        _Cycle('void-settings-screen', 'screen', labelFor(cfg.type), cycleScreen),\n"
pos = text.find(anchor_line)
print('pos', pos)
assert pos != -1
insert_lines = [
"        if (cfg is CassetteScreenConfig) ...[",
"          _Cycle(",
"            'void-settings-cassette-variant',",
"            'variant',",
"            cassetteVariantMeta[cfg.variant]!.label,",
"            () {",
"              final next = CassetteVariant.values[(cfg.variant.index + 1) % CassetteVariant.values.length];",
"              settings.saveScreenConfig(cfg.copyWith(variant: next));",
"            },",
"          ),",
"        ],\n",
]
new_text = text[:pos+len(anchor_line)] + '\n'.join(insert_lines) + text[pos+len(anchor_line):]
p.write_text(new_text)
print('Patch Step 1 completed')
